items.html: And when the light of Daat rose to its place above, the vessel of Keter grew, and extended until opposite the place of the end of all of Tifferet, and then the lower half of the light of Tifferet that had risen above, as was said, now returned to descend to its true place as at first. And the cause of the growth of the vessel of Keter was because of the light of Daat that clothed in it and made it grow, and also because Daat includes all of VAK and is a soul to them, as is known. Therefore, since it rose, it gave power to the vessel and made it grow, in order to benefit the light of Tifferet so that it would descend and be in its proper place.
